words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100.4 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 100.6 (open, price, submit).

As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is present; Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is present; Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank” is present.
